Owner: Intaglio general plot range/layout policy; PLS Neuro consumer bd-01M1XYE51VCHZRQS0NR3YQBBD4 owns recipe adoption and dock sizing. Independently reproduced through the ordinary public plot/aes/continuous-scale/size/geomPoint/renderPlan API in the actual current PairedScorePlot source, recompiled against copied dependencies and Intaglio 38e8c62 plus sparse-axis patch a59c71afc3c5ac2a1b0f550355b740edfa30829f9201896a0826215dd50699ca. At 640x220, selected size 5.5 pt extends beyond the default 5-percent expanded panel and is clipped; 640x360 is intact. Extrema remain exact +/-0.49999999999999983. Retained before/after SVG and PNG: /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/output/plot-review-v0/intaglio-axis/consumer-before and consumer-after. Plot compiler RangeExpansion.default uses 0.05; actual shape/stroke bounds are not a lower bound on that framing. Merely turning clipping off, rounding data, shrinking selection marks to hide the defect, or enlarging every plot by a fixture-specific constant does not meet acceptance.
Acceptance: a reusable, explicitly contracted device-extent framing capability preserves whole point ink and reasonable breathing room at compact/native/HiDPI/export sizes; obey explicit zoom and clipping choices; unchanged observation identity and coordinates, including transformed/flipped/faceted axes and all supported point shapes/strokes or explicit capability limits. Use independent actual device-bound/clip containment checks, native JVM/JS tests and current consumer screenshots; every specimen receives recorded image critique. Inspect selection state changes for unwanted plot motion and benchmark re-layout if multi-pass. Current compact consumer specimens are REVISE, not approved. This issue is separate from the completed sparse tick policy and must be resolved before the consumer axis/mark quality ticket closes.
set.title: Fit point ink inside automatically framed compact panels
